# Capsules & Health Ingredients

As a global leader in capsule design, manufacturing and encapsulation technology, we are dedicated
to create customized solutions that help you deliver groundbreaking health products to the market.

Backed by an ecosystem of technological insights, world class manufacturing, scientific expertise
and process excellence, we can support your brand throughout the entire development lifecycle.

#### With over 100 years of dosage expertise, we help our customers configure a wide variety of
#### capsule solutions to meet many common applications

#### ~120 patent families including more than 40 ingredient and over 80 capsule and dosage form
#### patent families, helping brands stand out

#### 7,000+ customers around the world leverage our comprehensive products and services, enabling
#### hundreds of millions of patients and consumers to live more active, healthier lives

## Partnering Across Industries

In today's dynamic healthcare environment, there is increasing pressure to balance speed to market
and manufacturing efficiency with product innovation and ever-evolving legislation. Choosing the
right partner is critical to your formulation success.

Our comprehensive suite of products and services includes specialty excipients, film coating
systems, controlled release formulation, and controlled atmosphere packaging.

[Industries_Nutra]

### Nutraceuticals & Dietary Supplements

We help develop the clean label tablets, capsules and gummies consumers love — leveraging the
expertise and discipline we have honed over 60+ years in the pharmaceutical industry.

[Discover More][127]
[Industries_Animal Health]

### Animal Health

Our innovative solutions enhance palatability, ensuring animals "receive" or "take" their
medications and supplements willingly. As a NASC Preferred Supplier, we're committed to delivering
high-quality ingredients for the animal health industry.

formulation. From the core to coating to packaging, they safeguard your medications and ensure
efficacy and reliability throughout shelf life.

Partner with our team to infuse your products with these industry-leading solutions proven to meet
the evolving needs of patients and professionals worldwide.

# Working Together for a Healthier World

Through a commitment to innovation, quality and collaboration, we ensure our customers' deliver
better medicines — faster, safer, and with confidence in quality.

[CC_Headers_Level01_Homepage]

At Colorcon, we promise to deliver excellence in every product, every process and every interaction.
Our science-based approach to product development drives innovation. Our people-centric approach to
customers and partners elevates it all.

[About Us][125]

## Partnering Across Industries

In today's dynamic healthcare environment, there is increasing pressure to balance speed to market
and manufacturing efficiency with product innovation and ever-evolving legislation. Choosing the
right partner is critical to your formulation success.

[Industries_Pharma]

### Pharmaceuticals

Our comprehensive suite of products and services includes specialty excipients, film coating
systems, controlled release formulation, and controlled atmosphere packaging.

[Discover More][126]
[Industries_Nutra]

### Nutraceuticals & Dietary Supplements

We help develop the clean label tablets, capsules and gummies consumers love — leveraging the
expertise and discipline we have honed over 60+ years in the pharmaceutical industry.

[Discover More][127]
[Industries_Animal Health]

### Animal Health

Our innovative solutions enhance palatability, ensuring animals "receive" or "take" their
medications and supplements willingly. As a NASC Preferred Supplier, we're committed to delivering
high-quality ingredients for the animal health industry.

[Discover More][128]

## Innovation From the Inside Out

Colorcon's comprehensive suite of products provides stability and protection for all aspects of
formulation. From the core to coating to packaging, they safeguard your medications and ensure
efficacy and reliability throughout shelf life.

Partner with our team to infuse your products with these industry-leading solutions proven to meet
the evolving needs of patients and professionals worldwide.

## [Advancing science to improve well-being][62]

Our business is to provide our customers and partners with expert, tailor-made and responsible
solutions in Pharmaceuticals and Personal care.

## People make our name

Since 1880, we share our scientific know-how towards improving well-being, health and beauty around
the world. We design, produce and market high-quality **pharmaceutical**** excipients** and
**natural cosmetic ingredients**, based on a deep understanding of our customers' needs.

## [Personal Care][63]

We are experts in two complementary fields: lipids and plant chemistry. This know-how enables us to
meet the latest market trends in both **natural performing actives** and **functional ingredients**,
recognized for their sensorial benefits.

## [Pharmaceuticals][64]

We offer **innovative lipid excipients** and **personalized technical support**, provided by fully
trained experts to accelerate customers’ development programs, for **pharmaceutical** and
**veterinary drugs**, as well as **dietary supplements**.

## News
* Corporate

### [Gattefossé accelerates production ramp-up at its Lufkin facility with eight validated
### ingredients][65]

Three pharmaceutical excipients and five cosmetic ingredients have now achieved manufacturing
equivalency.
[Lufkin plant]
* Personal care

### [Gattefossé unveils Silkaress™ and wraps skin with silk-like softness][66]

Silkaress™ mirrors the protective function of silk and responds to the current challenges of
adapting to unpredictable, sometimes extreme changes in the environment.
* Personal care

### [When science meets the senses: Gattefossé celebrates 30 years of sensory expertise
### excellence][67]

Since 1996, we have developed a structured approach to understand and measure sensory perceptions,
supporting the creation of high-performance formulations from the very design of its ingredients.
[30 years sensory expertise]

## [Advancing science to improve well-being][62]

Our business is to provide our customers and partners with expert, tailor-made and responsible
solutions in Pharmaceuticals and Personal care.

## People make our name

Since 1880, we share our scientific know-how towards improving well-being, health and beauty around
the world. We design, produce and market high-quality **pharmaceutical**** excipients** and
**natural cosmetic ingredients**, based on a deep understanding of our customers' needs.

## [Personal Care][63]

We are experts in two complementary fields: lipids and plant chemistry. This know-how enables us to
meet the latest market trends in both **natural performing actives** and **functional ingredients**,
recognized for their sensorial benefits.

## [Pharmaceuticals][64]

We offer **innovative lipid excipients** and **personalized technical support**, provided by fully
trained experts to accelerate customers’ development programs, for **pharmaceutical** and
**veterinary drugs**, as well as **dietary supplements**.

## Zofingen

Switzerland

Zofingen is the headquarters of the Siegfried Group and one of Siegfried’s two launch sites for
newly developed processes. The production site specializes in the development and commercial
manufacturing of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and intermediates, including high potency
APIs. Founded in 1873, the site has a broad portfolio of technological capabilities including
hydrogenation, organometallic and hydride chemistry, halogenation, methylation, milling and
micronization and more. All activities are conducted in strict compliance with quality standards
(GMPs) and with safety, health protection and environmental standards.

**Competencies**
* Active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) and intermediates
* Highly active and controlled substances
* Custom synthesis

newly developed processes. The production site specializes in the development and commercial
manufacturing of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and intermediates, including high potency
APIs. Founded in 1873, the site has a broad portfolio of technological capabilities including
hydrogenation, organometallic and hydride chemistry, halogenation, methylation, milling and
micronization and more. All activities are conducted in strict compliance with quality standards
(GMPs) and with safety, health protection and environmental standards.

Ever since we first lifted the lid on our paints and coatings in 1792, we’ve been coloring people’s
lives and protecting what matters most. From deep underground, to homes, cities, transport and even
outer space, we use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life.

Let's Paint the Future together.

## Colors of the Year 2026

Get into the swing of things with Rhythm of Blues, our Colors of the Year for 2026. It’s an upbeat
and versatile color family based around three shades that are designed to bring calm, balance and
energy. The focus is on your space, your pace to help you create a visual soundtrack that gets your
mojo working.

[ Read more ][53]

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

### [2026 Nasal & Inhalation Drug Development & Delivery eBook: Drug Repurposing Creates New Market
### Opportunities][16]

In this exclusive seventh annual nasal and inhalation eBook, Drug Development & Delivery highlights
how these routes of administration are bringing new life to orphaned drugs and open new
opportunities for treatment beyond pulmonary and respiratory diseases. We also explore the
challenges of nose-to-brain delivery, next-generation propellants, overcoming the limitations of dry
powder inhalers, and successful formulation strategies.

[Featured Articles][17]

### [SPECIAL FEATURE - Outsourcing Formulation Development & Manufacturing: Connecting Your Project
### to the Right Service Provider][18]

Outsourcing formulation development and manufacturing can help drug developers address complex
dosage forms, scale-up risks, regulatory demands, and accelerated timelines by connecting projects
with CDMO partners that offer specialized expertise, integrated workflows, and scalable
manufacturing support.

[Featured Articles][19]

### [SPECIAL REPORT - Advancements in Respiratory Drug Delivery][20]

Advances in inhaled drug delivery are improving how therapies reach the lungs, with innovations in
formulations, devices, biologics, and digital tools helping expand treatment options for respiratory
diseases.

[Featured Articles][21]

### [CAR T CELL THERAPY - The Rise of Scalable Allogeneic CAR T: Shaping a New Era in Oncology][22]

Allogeneic CAR T therapies are helping move oncology toward more scalable, off-the-shelf treatment
models that could expand access, support earlier intervention, and bring advanced cell therapy
closer to community cancer settings.

[Featured Articles][23]

### [EXECUTIVE INTERVIEW - Dr. Michalis Papadakis Founder & CEO Brainomix][24]

Brainomix founder and CEO Dr. Michalis Papadakis discusses how AI-powered imaging is helping drug
developers improve clinical trial design, identify meaningful treatment effects, and advance new
therapies in stroke, pulmonary fibrosis, and other areas of unmet need.

[Featured Articles][25]

### [DRUG-DEVICE COMBINATION PRODUCTS - Incorporating Self-Administered Drug-Device Combination
### Products Into Clinical Trials Can Bring Outsized Challenges & Outstanding Rewards][26]

Self-administered drug-device combination products can bring major benefits to clinical trials,
improving patient convenience, dosing consistency, compliance, and real-world insight, but they
require careful early planning around usability, safety, regulatory requirements, compatibility,
manufacturing, and scale-up.

[Featured Articles][27]

### [DRUG DELIVERY - Improved Prediction of Food Effect on Oral Absorption][28]

Dissolution-permeation testing is helping drug developers better predict how food affects oral drug
absorption by measuring both drug solubilization and membrane permeation, reducing the risk of
misleading results from dissolution data alone.

[Featured Articles][29]

### [DRUG DEVELOPMENT - Drug Combination Screening in Oncology: Advancing Predictive Strategies for
### Precision Drug Development][30]

Drug combination screening is helping oncology developers identify synergistic drug pairs, connect
response patterns to tumor biology, and support more predictive, biomarker-guided strategies for
precision cancer treatment.

[Featured Articles][31]

### [SINGLE B CELL ANTIBODY DISCOVERY - Improving Therapeutic Candidate Selection in Drug
### Development][32]

Single B cell antibody discovery is helping improve therapeutic candidate selection by preserving
native heavy- and light-chain pairing, accelerating sequence-defined screening, and enabling earlier
identification of candidates with stronger specificity, function, and developability.

[Featured Articles][33]

### [CHEMOENZYMATIC LIGATION - Enabling Scalable, Sustainable Oligonucleotide Manufacturing][34]

Chemoenzymatic ligation offers a scalable, more sustainable path for oligonucleotide manufacturing
by combining SPOS fragment production with enzymatic assembly to improve purity, reduce impurities,
and support growing demand for nucleic acid therapeutics.

[Featured Articles][35]

### [CONTROLLED RELEASE - Precision in Every Dose: Advancing Controlled Release for Small Molecule
### Therapeutics][36]

Controlled release technologies are helping small molecule therapeutics deliver more consistent drug
exposure, improve patient adherence, reduce dosing frequency, and support more precise treatment
through advanced formulation and delivery strategies.

[Featured Articles][37]

About Us
Chitra Machineries Pvt. Ltd. is a well-known development firm that offers its clients a wide range
of industrial used products. Over the years, our name has been synonymous with the design and
manufacture of high-quality machinery for the food, cosmetics, chemical, medicine, and
pharmaceutical industries. Our offered range includes items like Contra Rotating Mixer, Double Cone
Blender, Automatic Tablet Coating System, Blender With V And Double Cone, Rapid Mixer Granulator,
and more. All of these products are made from high-quality raw materials, processed using advanced
equipment, and packaged in accordance with worldwide industrial standards. Along with these items,
we offer extended after-sales service to our clients across the world at cheap costs.

From idea creation, R&D, and design to contract manufacture, packing, and final shipment, we are
one-stop shop for a diverse range of machinery solutions. Our knowledge is respected and used by
both large and small businesses to maximize the return on capital equipment. Building our business
by collaborating with our customers, we have established the methods and technologies to build all
types of customized machinery to match the exact specifications of our clients, based on the process
and production requirements of our customers. We always judge and measure our success based on the
success of our customers, regardless of the quantity of the order. Our dedication and years of
experience has made us one of the most reliable manufacturer and supplier in the market.

**Our Strengths **

Our innate strengths have given us a competitive advantage in our industry. These includes:

* We continue to invest in our infrastructure to improve the quality and performance of our
  products, as well as our response to the individual needs of our customers. Our new equipment
  manufacturing plant is approximately 33,000 square feet in size, with an additional 22,000 square
  feet of building space.      
* We manufacture each products with the purpose to provide equipment that allows our customers to
  achieve their unique business goals.
* We preserve all of the relevant information for each machine we supply. With this information, we
  can provide reliable after-sales care to our valued clients.
* We have established an R&D section that aims to improve our existing product line while also
  conducting research on new equipment.
* We always aim to achieve total customer satisfaction. Improving the businesses of our customers
  through our products is a top priority, thus we hire the most knowledgeable and devoted team
  members. We train them to perform their best and make every transaction valuable and profitable
  for our clients.

# Μια ελληνική παράδοση **ποιότητας και καινοτομίας**

Ιδρυμένη το 1968, η KARAMANIS έχει εξελιχθεί  σε κατασκευαστή επικαλύψεων με ζάχαρη και σε κορυφαίο
προμηθευτή επικαλύψεων με σοκολάτα. Με ισχυρή δέσμευση στην ποιότητα, την καινοτομία και την
ικανοποίηση των πελατών, έχουμε χτίσει μια φήμη για την αριστεία στον κλάδο.


[Follow a manual added link][30]

# Το ταξίδι μας

**Ξεχωρίζοντας στην επικάλυψη από το 1968**

Από μια μικρή ελληνική εταιρεία , εξελιχθήκαμε σε ηγέτη του κλάδου στην επικάλυψη ζάχαρης και την
επεξεργασία σοκολάτας. Η προσπάθειά μας για καινοτομία και τεχνογνωσία μας επέτρεψε να επεκτείνουμε
την γκάμα των προϊόντων μας, προσφέροντας προϊόντα που καλύπτουν τις ανάγκες των εταιρειών τροφίμων,
ζαχαρωδών προϊόντων και λιανικής πώλησης. Σήμερα, τα τελικά προϊόντα μας αγαπιούνται από αρτοποιεία,
ζαχαροπλάστες, λιανοπωλητές και οργανωτές εκδηλώσεων.

**Οικογενειακή Χειροτεχνία**

Η Karamanis είναι μια πραγματική οικογενειακή επιχείρηση, όπου όλα τα μέλη συνεργάζονται με μια
εξαιρετική ομάδα και ένα κοινό πάθος για καλαίσθητα προϊόντα, δημιουργώντας προϊόντα υψηλής
ποιότητας βασισμένα στην παράδοση, την εμπιστοσύνη και τη δεξιοτεχνία.

**1968 – σήμερα**

**Αν είναι βρώσιμο,
θα βρούμε έναν τρόπο να το επικαλύψουμε.**

### Cookie and Privacy Settings


Πως χρησιμοποιούμε τα cookies

Ενδέχεται να ζητήσουμε την εγκατάσταση cookies στη συσκευή σας. Χρησιμοποιούμε cookies για να μας
ενημερώνετε πότε επισκέπτεστε τους ιστότοπούς μας, πώς αλληλεπιδράτε μαζί μας, για να εμπλουτίσουμε
την εμπειρία χρήστη και για να προσαρμόσουμε τη σχέση σας με τον ιστότοπό μας.

Κάντε κλικ στις διαφορετικές επικεφαλίδες κατηγοριών για να μάθετε περισσότερα. Μπορείτε επίσης να
αλλάξετε ορισμένες από τις προτιμήσεις σας. Λάβετε υπόψη ότι ο αποκλεισμός ορισμένων τύπων cookies
ενδέχεται να επηρεάσει την εμπειρία σας στους ιστότοπούς μας και τις υπηρεσίες που μπορούμε να
προσφέρουμε.

Βασικά cookies ιστότοπου

Αυτά τα cookies είναι απολύτως απαραίτητα για να σας παρέχουμε υπηρεσίες που διατίθενται μέσω του
ιστότοπού μας και να χρησιμοποιείτε ορισμένες από τις λειτουργίες του.

Επειδή αυτά τα cookies είναι απολύτως απαραίτητα για την παροχή του ιστότοπου, δεν μπορείτε να τα
αρνηθείτε χωρίς να επηρεάσετε τον τρόπο λειτουργίας του ιστότοπού μας. Μπορείτε να τα αποκλείσετε ή
να τα διαγράψετε αλλάζοντας τις ρυθμίσεις του προγράμματος περιήγησής σας και να επιβάλετε τον
αποκλεισμό όλων των cookies σε αυτόν τον ιστότοπο.

Google Analytics Cookies

Αυτά τα cookies συλλέγουν πληροφορίες που χρησιμοποιούνται είτε σε συγκεντρωτική μορφή για να μας
βοηθήσουν να κατανοήσουμε πώς χρησιμοποιείται ο ιστότοπός μας ή πόσο αποτελεσματικές είναι οι

# Sustainable Nutrition

At Kerry, we enable better food and beverage; partnering with our customers to create healthier,
tastier, and more sustainable products that are enjoyed by consumers all around the world.

 

[Learn more][89]

## Latest news

Discover what’s on the horizon for food, beverage and pharma.

### The Reformulation Trap: Why Better-for-You Bakery So Often Tastes Like It

[Read more][90]

### From Hormonal Chaos to Cycle Confidence: Why Fertility Support is Being Rethought Across Asia

[Read more][91]

## Don't wait, reformulate 

Reformulating products to meet consumer expectations amidst complex regulatory environments, rising
costs, and global supply chain disruptions can be overwhelming. Add shifting consumer priorities
around health and sustainability to the mix, and the need for fast, effective solutions is
undeniable. The good news? We're ready for it.

[Learn more][93]
[person drinking juice]

From Food For Food

## Delivering value for our partners for over 50 years.

We play our part in tackling global health challenges by reducing excess salt and sugar, increasing
fibre intake, eliminating harmful compounds in foods, and pioneering solutions that manage profound
health challenges. Through our work with customers, we’re helping c. 1.5 billion people eat
healthier, more nutritious food, with a goal of reaching 2 billion by 2030. 

[Learn more][94]
[couple sharing a sandwich]

## Clinical science with human impact.

By combining premium, clinically proven ingredients with our unmatched ingenuity in taste, we’re
creating leading-edge health and wellness solutions that blend the very best of science, sourcing
and sensory.

[Explore Supplement solutions][95]
[african woman proudly smiling]

## Nutritionally Optimised. Taste Maximised. 

Taste is the ultimate non-negotiable.   

As consumers continue to seek out healthier lifestyles and practices, sugar and artificial
sweeteners are in the spotlight.

This is where Kerry can come in. Customer solutions like our Tastesense™ Advanced can reduce sugar
by up to 80% using only natural ingredients and with no compromise on taste. 

[Explore our Taste solutions][96]

# Creating a world of
# 
# Sustainable Nutrition

At Kerry, we enable better food and beverage; partnering with our customers to create healthier,
tastier, and more sustainable products that are enjoyed by consumers all around the world.

 

[Learn more][89]

## Latest news

Discover what’s on the horizon for food, beverage and pharma.

### The Reformulation Trap: Why Better-for-You Bakery So Often Tastes Like It

[Read more][90]

### From Hormonal Chaos to Cycle Confidence: Why Fertility Support is Being Rethought Across Asia

[Read more][91]

### Kerry Welcomes Harvard’s Professor of the Global Food System to Ireland for Discussion on the
### Future of Food

[Read more][92]

In a squeeze?

## Don't wait, reformulate 

Reformulating products to meet consumer expectations amidst complex regulatory environments, rising
costs, and global supply chain disruptions can be overwhelming. Add shifting consumer priorities
around health and sustainability to the mix, and the need for fast, effective solutions is
undeniable. The good news? We're ready for it.

[Learn more][93]
[person drinking juice]

From Food For Food

## Delivering value for our partners for over 50 years.

We play our part in tackling global health challenges by reducing excess salt and sugar, increasing
fibre intake, eliminating harmful compounds in foods, and pioneering solutions that manage profound
health challenges. Through our work with customers, we’re helping c. 1.5 billion people eat
healthier, more nutritious food, with a goal of reaching 2 billion by 2030. 

[Learn more][94]
[couple sharing a sandwich]

## Clinical science with human impact.

By combining premium, clinically proven ingredients with our unmatched ingenuity in taste, we’re
creating leading-edge health and wellness solutions that blend the very best of science, sourcing
and sensory.

[Explore Supplement solutions][95]
[african woman proudly smiling]

## Nutritionally Optimised. Taste Maximised. 

Taste is the ultimate non-negotiable.   

As consumers continue to seek out healthier lifestyles and practices, sugar and artificial
sweeteners are in the spotlight.

This is where Kerry can come in. Customer solutions like our Tastesense™ Advanced can reduce sugar
by up to 80% using only natural ingredients and with no compromise on taste. 

[Explore our Taste solutions][96]
[african woman proudly smiling]

Our motto is #krytexpower.

KRYTEX™ stands for innovation and groundbreaking products. It all began with a scientific
breakthrough in hydrophobic coatings, leading to a revolutionary formula that quickly gained demand.

From there, we expanded into marketing, promotion, and the production of advanced ceramic coatings
for professionals. Today, our products inspire dealers and partners to achieve more, and we support
them every step of the way.

A key advantage of KRYTEX™ is our in-house manufacturing. By producing every component ourselves, we
ensure high quality and stable, competitive pricing.

Our factories are in Europe, with a central office in Bratislava, Slovakia, and a main office in
Boca Raton, Florida, USA. We proudly manufacture under our own brand and our own trademark.

All products are certified, lab-tested, and backed by comprehensive safety documentation.

quality, durability, and ease of use.

  low-skilled personnel
* Creates an anti-graffiti effect when two layers are applied
* Enhances shine, depth and intensity of paintwork color

## Kima Chemical Co.,Ltd

Kima Chemical is a methyl cellulose ether supplier from China, producing 20000 tons of cellulose
ether annually and become one of the most professional [cellulose ether factory][25] globally.

Hydroxyethyl Cellulose (HEC), Methyl Hydroxyethyl Cellulose (MHEC),Sodium Carboxymethyl Cellulose
(CMC), Ethyl Cellulose(EC), Hydroxypropyl Cellulose (HPC), Methyl Cellulose(MC), Low Substitute
Hydroxypropyl Cellulose (L-HPC), Hydroxypropyl Methyl Cellulose Phthalate (HPMC-P),Polyanionic
cellulose (PAC) etc. Kima Chemical is one of world famous [cellulose ether producer][26], our
product can be widely used in construction,water based paint,building, pharmaceutical, food,
cosmetic, detergent,home care,tile adhesive,dry mixed mortar ,wall putty, etc applications.

## "As a leading innovative automotive painting company we bring creativity to paint"

Part of the Nippon Paint Group, which was created over 140 years ago, NPAC was established in
February 1971 and is a leading global paint manufacturer that handles in-house all automotive
coatings, from electrodeposition paint (E-coat), primer, and basecoat/clearcoat for the auto body to
paint for plastic bumpers and interior parts. With a diverse and highly passionate workforce of
38,000 within the corporation and 5,800 automotive specialists, we draw on our knowledge of the
overall automotive painting process and our wealth of coating expertise; we have created a system
that maximises the properties of each coat and paint film while creating synergy.

With five sites across Europe and links to our global partners, we are in a strong position to
support the European and global markets around the world. We understand the local needs of our
customers in every community. Each company embraces diversity and operates together, creating a
strong and unified global presence.

[ Our Company ][29]
[ Our Culture ][30]

# Coating Solutions

Steel plate and aluminium materials are widely used in the auto body. The surface is treated with a
chemical conversion coating before the painting process. Several coats are then applied in order…

[ecoat][ecoat]

#### E-coat

The E-coat is an undercoat used for automotive OEMs, developed for anti-corrosion protection and
appearance improvement.

[ More >> ][31]
[primer][primer]

#### Primer

Primer is applied to the E-coat before the basecoat and clearcoat, preparing the E-coat surface for
the finished topcoat result.

[ More >> ][32]
[basecoat][basecoat]

#### Basecoat

The basecoat brings colour to the complete paint system. Common basecoats are solvent-based,
water-based and now primerless.

[ More >> ][33]
[clearcoat][clearcoat]

#### Clearcoat

This is the final layer of the automotive coating. The clearcoat paint gives the car’s body and
plastic parts the final gloss appearance.

[ More >> ][34]
[plastic coatings][plastic coatings]

#### Plastic Coating

NPAC offers a full range of automotive OEM paint coatings for integrated plastic parts, including
Polypropylene and ABS.

[ More >> ][35]
[interior coating][interior coating]

#### Interior Coating

NPAC offers a full range of interior painting solutions for all requirements to ensure the same
high-quality finish that our customers expect.

[ More >> ][36]

## Maximum Performance

We design each coat with the utmost care, taking into account the effect of one on another in the
painting process and ensuring that the final multi-layer paint film achieves maximum performance.

**Paint for plastic parts**

Lightweight plastic is not just used for bumpers. It is also used for other automotive parts in
response to needs, such as reducing vehicle weight and extending design possibilities.

With plastic bumpers, a primer is first applied to improve the adhesion of the paint to the product,
and then basecoat and clearcoat for colour and lustre. We are also designing paints tailored to the
material and use of various components other than bumpers.

[ More >> ][37]
[maximum results][maximum results]
[nippon paint automotive coatings][nippon paint automotive coatings]

## Enhancing Driver Experience

Cars are not only a mode of transportation but also a vital item for enriching our lifestyle. We
seek to enhance the car’s value through paint and paint film and deliver fresh delight to the
driver.

**Solutions for enhancing vehicle value**

One of our major initiatives in this area is the development of Premium Colour products based on
in-house research and our proprietary expertise.

Cars featuring Premium Colour are proving popular for the added value provided by innovative colour
designs, addressing driver preferences, trends, and owner satisfaction.

[ More >> ][38]
[ ][39]

Nippon Paint is a global leader, providing innovative solutions in the paint and coatings industry
for over 140 years.

## "As a leading innovative automotive painting company we bring creativity to paint"

Part of the Nippon Paint Group, which was created over 140 years ago, NPAC was established in
February 1971 and is a leading global paint manufacturer that handles in-house all automotive
coatings, from electrodeposition paint (E-coat), primer, and basecoat/clearcoat for the auto body to
paint for plastic bumpers and interior parts. With a diverse and highly passionate workforce of
38,000 within the corporation and 5,800 automotive specialists, we draw on our knowledge of the
overall automotive painting process and our wealth of coating expertise; we have created a system
that maximises the properties of each coat and paint film while creating synergy.

With five sites across Europe and links to our global partners, we are in a strong position to
support the European and global markets around the world. We understand the local needs of our
customers in every community. Each company embraces diversity and operates together, creating a
strong and unified global presence.

[ Our Company ][29]
[ Our Culture ][30]

# Coating Solutions

Steel plate and aluminium materials are widely used in the auto body. The surface is treated with a
chemical conversion coating before the painting process. Several coats are then applied in order…

[ecoat][ecoat]

#### E-coat

The E-coat is an undercoat used for automotive OEMs, developed for anti-corrosion protection and
appearance improvement.

[ More >> ][31]
[primer][primer]

#### Primer

Primer is applied to the E-coat before the basecoat and clearcoat, preparing the E-coat surface for
the finished topcoat result.

[ More >> ][32]
[basecoat][basecoat]

#### Basecoat

The basecoat brings colour to the complete paint system. Common basecoats are solvent-based,
water-based and now primerless.

[ More >> ][33]
[clearcoat][clearcoat]

#### Clearcoat

This is the final layer of the automotive coating. The clearcoat paint gives the car’s body and
plastic parts the final gloss appearance.

[ More >> ][34]
[plastic coatings][plastic coatings]

#### Plastic Coating

NPAC offers a full range of automotive OEM paint coatings for integrated plastic parts, including
Polypropylene and ABS.

[ More >> ][35]
[interior coating][interior coating]

#### Interior Coating

NPAC offers a full range of interior painting solutions for all requirements to ensure the same
high-quality finish that our customers expect.

[ More >> ][36]

## Maximum Performance

We design each coat with the utmost care, taking into account the effect of one on another in the
painting process and ensuring that the final multi-layer paint film achieves maximum performance.

**Paint for plastic parts**

Lightweight plastic is not just used for bumpers. It is also used for other automotive parts in
response to needs, such as reducing vehicle weight and extending design possibilities.

With plastic bumpers, a primer is first applied to improve the adhesion of the paint to the product,
and then basecoat and clearcoat for colour and lustre. We are also designing paints tailored to the
material and use of various components other than bumpers.

[ More >> ][37]
[maximum results][maximum results]
[nippon paint automotive coatings][nippon paint automotive coatings]

## Enhancing Driver Experience

Cars are not only a mode of transportation but also a vital item for enriching our lifestyle. We
seek to enhance the car’s value through paint and paint film and deliver fresh delight to the
driver.

**Solutions for enhancing vehicle value**

One of our major initiatives in this area is the development of Premium Colour products based on
in-house research and our proprietary expertise.

Cars featuring Premium Colour are proving popular for the added value provided by innovative colour
designs, addressing driver preferences, trends, and owner satisfaction.

for over 140 years.

## ABOUT NIPSEA GROUP

60+ Years of experience

NIPSEA Group is a global leader, providing innovative solutions in the paint and coatings industry.
Headquartered in Singapore, with more than 148 NIPSEA companies spread throughout 28 geographical
locations, the group is Asia Pacific’s No. 1 paint and coatings manufacturer in both production and
sales revenue. After more than 60 years of growth, NIPSEA Group has over 31,000 employees with 118
manufacturing facilities and operations, efficiently serving all aspects of the business, from
production to customer satisfaction. With a focus on maximizing value to our customers, we push
boundaries to deliver high quality solutions that work better for all our partners, tradesmen, and
homeowners. The NIPSEA Group’s arsenal of solutions for the industry covers Architectural,
Industrial, Automotive and Marine Coatings, as well as a range of products beyond the world of paint
and coatings. We have an unyielding drive to focus on customers, providing innovation that works
best for all our stakeholders.

Nippon Paint – We are Inspired by You.

## ABOUT NIPSEA GROUP

60+ Years of experience

NIPSEA Group is a global leader, providing innovative solutions in the paint and coatings industry.
Headquartered in Singapore, with more than 148 NIPSEA companies spread throughout 28 geographical
locations, the group is Asia Pacific’s No. 1 paint and coatings manufacturer in both production and
sales revenue. After more than 60 years of growth, NIPSEA Group has over 31,000 employees with 118
manufacturing facilities and operations, efficiently serving all aspects of the business, from
production to customer satisfaction. With a focus on maximizing value to our customers, we push
boundaries to deliver high quality solutions that work better for all our partners, tradesmen, and
homeowners. The NIPSEA Group’s arsenal of solutions for the industry covers Architectural,
Industrial, Automotive and Marine Coatings, as well as a range of products beyond the world of paint
and coatings. We have an unyielding drive to focus on customers, providing innovation that works
best for all our stakeholders.

Nippon Paint – We are Inspired by You.

# Superyacht & Industrial Coating Consult & Inspection Services
#  

Get flawless finishes, zero surprises, and bullet‑proof documentation: on yachts, tanks, and
critical infrastructure.

Trusted on high‑stakes assets around the world:

 · 550+ superyacht paint surveys (~$3B asset value)

 · 14M gallons municipal water storage

 · 7M gallons DoD jet fuel tanks

 · 15M sq ft structural steel

 · 7.7M cubic ft wastewater structures.
* Yachts – Paint surveys, QA/hold‑point inspections, full owner’s‑rep QA/QC.
* Infrastructure – Water/Wastewater, Industrial / Commercial, Bridges / Overpasses.
* Defense – Navy, Coast Guard, and other DoD assets.
* Oil & Gas – Refinery Plants, Pipelines, Storage Tanks, Off-Shore Rigs, etc.  

What you get
* Clarity before you spend — objective paint/gelcoat surveys with quantified defects and costed
  options.

* Control during execution — hold‑point QA that prevents rework and change‑order games.

* Cover your downside — defensible reports, test data, and expert testimony when projects go
  sideways.

How engagement works (3 steps)

   1. Assess – 15‑minute triage call + file review.


   2. Scope – Fixed‑fee proposal tied to project value and deliverables.


   3. Execute – Schedule, inspect, report with actionable documentation.

## ABOUT US

Revay Coating Consultants, Inc. (RCCI) is Fort Lauderdale, FL-based consulting and inspection
company that is overflowing with technical knowledge, deep experience, and a genuine passion for all
things related to coatings & corrosion mitigation. RCCI provides various services, such as Quality
Assurance / Control (QA / QC) Coating Inspections, Paints / Coatings / Corrosion based Consulting
Services, Failure Analysis / Root-Cause Investigations, and Expert Witness Services.

 

The founder of RCCI, Mr. David V. Revay, has over fourteen years of experience within the coating /
corrosion industry and he has great enthusiasm for this industry. RCCI's expertise in coatings /
paint systems, corrosion mitigation, and assistance with choosing building materials (preventing /
reducing galvanic corrosion) within the following industries:

 

- Superyacht & Marine coatings  (private pleasure crafts, commercial ships, cruise ships, etc.)

- Water and Wastewater treatment facilities and assets

- Department of Transportation   (i.e., bridges, overpasses, etc.) 

- Department of Defense   (i.e., Navy and Coast Guard vessels and assets)

- Oil and Natural Gas (i.e.: pipelines, tanks, etc.)

- and so much more.

 

RCCI provides services to domestic and international clients.

# Superyacht & Industrial Coating Consult & Inspection Services
#  

Get flawless finishes, zero surprises, and bullet‑proof documentation: on yachts, tanks, and
critical infrastructure.

Trusted on high‑stakes assets around the world:

 · 550+ superyacht paint surveys (~$3B asset value)

 · 14M gallons municipal water storage

 · 7M gallons DoD jet fuel tanks

 · 15M sq ft structural steel

 · 7.7M cubic ft wastewater structures.
* Yachts – Paint surveys, QA/hold‑point inspections, full owner’s‑rep QA/QC.
* Infrastructure – Water/Wastewater, Industrial / Commercial, Bridges / Overpasses.
* Defense – Navy, Coast Guard, and other DoD assets.
* Oil & Gas – Refinery Plants, Pipelines, Storage Tanks, Off-Shore Rigs, etc.  

What you get
* Clarity before you spend — objective paint/gelcoat surveys with quantified defects and costed
  options.

* Control during execution — hold‑point QA that prevents rework and change‑order games.

* Cover your downside — defensible reports, test data, and expert testimony when projects go
  sideways.

How engagement works (3 steps)

   1. Assess – 15‑minute triage call + file review.


   2. Scope – Fixed‑fee proposal tied to project value and deliverables.


   3. Execute – Schedule, inspect, report with actionable documentation.

## ABOUT US

Revay Coating Consultants, Inc. (RCCI) is Fort Lauderdale, FL-based consulting and inspection
company that is overflowing with technical knowledge, deep experience, and a genuine passion for all
things related to coatings & corrosion mitigation. RCCI provides various services, such as Quality
Assurance / Control (QA / QC) Coating Inspections, Paints / Coatings / Corrosion based Consulting
Services, Failure Analysis / Root-Cause Investigations, and Expert Witness Services.

 

The founder of RCCI, Mr. David V. Revay, has over fourteen years of experience within the coating /
corrosion industry and he has great enthusiasm for this industry. RCCI's expertise in coatings /
paint systems, corrosion mitigation, and assistance with choosing building materials (preventing /
reducing galvanic corrosion) within the following industries:

 

- Superyacht & Marine coatings  (private pleasure crafts, commercial ships, cruise ships, etc.)

- Water and Wastewater treatment facilities and assets

- Department of Transportation   (i.e., bridges, overpasses, etc.) 

- Department of Defense   (i.e., Navy and Coast Guard vessels and assets)

- Oil and Natural Gas (i.e.: pipelines, tanks, etc.)

- and so much more.

 

RCCI provides services to domestic and international clients.

## Over 130 years of expertise. A new beginning.

We are Surventis - formerly known as BASF Coatings - a global leader in automotive coatings and
surface treatment. Following the agreement between BASF and Carlyle, we have become an independent,
standalone company: a new identity, built on continuity.

Our new chapter builds on the foundations that have made us strong: deep technical expertise,
long-standing customer relationships, trusted heritage brands, and a culture shaped over more than
130 years. As an independent company, we now move with greater entrepreneurial freedom, faster
decision-making and agility, backed by Carlyle's global network and commitment to our growth.

## Frequently Asked Questions
* #### What Types of Tablet Coatings Do You Offer?
  
  There are several types of coating materials for tablets that coat surfaces differently and affect
  the end result of the medication in unique ways. Our machines are capable of producing [various
  types of tablet coating processes][51], like sugar, film, enteric-coated, extended release, and
  active drug layering solutions.
* #### What Type of Spray Gun Comes With Your Machines?
  
  All of our tablet coating machines are equipped with the patented [Thomas Spray Bar.][52] Designed
  with GMP considerations in mind, our system is fully integrated to offer accurate solution
  delivery rate, >5% gun to gun spray rate differential, and rapid disassembly and cleaning.
* #### Do You Offer Spare Part Kits?
  
  Yes, we offer two types of [spare part kits][53] to prevent operation downtime. Our consumable
  kits include parts required for preventive maintenance and GMP replacement. Our emergency kits
  include components recommended to be kept onsite to minimize downtime in the event of a component
  failure.
